additional_info.subject: RE: ID0416831-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002121] technical error CRM:02679000045
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
We have identified an issue with the LEM meter at DC1, which appears to have caused an interruption. As a temporary measure, the LEM meter has been disabled, and the outlet is now functioning normally.
To resolve this, please schedule a site intervention with the following objectives:
Inspect the LEM meter to determine if the unit itself is faulty or if there is a connectivity issue with the sensor.
Check all connections to ensure there is no loose or damaged wiring.
If the meter is confirmed to be faulty, proceed with a replacement during the same visit to minimize downtime.
MLFB No.  8EM5903-0AA00-0AA3 -BC1.1, -BC1.2, -BC2.1, -BC2.2, DC Meter 400A Standard 4 mOhm.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0416831-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002121] technical error CRM:02679000045
additional_info.body:
Dear Chloë D'hose,
I wanted to provide you with an update regarding the recent issue experienced with the charger.
It appears that the LEM meter may be at fault. We have already recommended RC to verify the behavior using another charger, as no other issues have been observed with the charger itself. There is a strong possibility that the LEM meter is malfunctioning.
Additionally, please note that yesterday we removed the LEM IP address from the configuration, which brought the outlet back online.
The "Out of Order" status you experienced was due to a temporary COAP error that lasted only about 5 seconds. We have since rebooted the charger, and we do not expect the issue to recur. However, if the issue persists, we will investigate further and check for any required updates.
RC will carry out further checks and reach out to you accordingly.
